When you are familiar with Vietnamese food like pho, banh xeo, and banh mi, go with your family before going to Korea.
I stopped by because I was thinking of Korean food. I came without expectations, but the food was delicious. I ate kimchi stew, spicy pork stir-fry, kimchi fried rice, grilled sea bream, and fried dumplings. 
Those who miss Korean food, come visit, you won't regret it. 
The kimchi fried rice was a little spicy for my 11-year-old brother. I think you use a sharp chili powder. My 6-year-old son
